evals.prompt: Check the staged proposal draft against the confirmed System Card and staged fresh brief. Do not rewrite it.
evals.expected_output: Exactly four quality-report sections without a rewrite.
expectations: Cites a specific sentence for every reported rule break.
Separates unsupported claims from style preferences using the fresh brief or an approved source.
Recommends one observable correction with pass and failure tests.

evals.prompt: My System Card only says 'make it sound confident'. Rewrite this draft to be better.
evals.expected_output: A stop on the vague, unconfirmed criterion.
expectations: Names the vague Card field that needs an owner decision.
Does not present generic style feedback as a Card-based evaluation.

evals.prompt: The System Card is confirmed and the draft is ready. Check whether all of its claims are supported, but I cannot provide the brief or approved facts.
evals.expected_output: A safe stop on the missing claim evidence.
expectations: Returns only the required-input stop response, not the four-section report.
Requests the exact fresh brief or approved fact list.
Does not judge, correct, or rewrite the draft.
